summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine PDMR share transactions under its supplemental savings and 401(k) plans. The transactions were notional ADS acquisitions on 2026-08-14 at $49.52 per ADS, totaling approximately 2,489 shares across four executives/directors, executed on the NYSE. These dividend reinvestment purchases are ordinary plan transactions with no corporate action, merger, tender offer, or strategic initiative involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer current report. No special-situation event is present, no board recommendation or advisors are mentioned, and no deal terms apply. Watch for nothing; this is purely administrative disclosure.
